FAQs - Florida Caverns RV Resort
Skip to content
FLORIDA CAVERNS RV RESORT
NORTH FLORIDA RV RESORT
FAQs
Frequently Asked Questions
We ve answered our most frequently asked questions below. Please contact our office by calling (850) 482-5583 if you have any remaining questions.
Where are you located?
Florida Caverns RV Resort is located at 4820 Highway 90, Marianna, Florida 32446 . We sit just off US Highway 90 near I-10.
What is the cancellation policy?
Reservations that are cancelled two days or more before the check-in date will be charged a $10 cancellation fee and will have the remaining balance paid as Camp Credit for a future stay. Reservations cancelled within 48 hours of the check-in date will be charged the full amount of the reservation balance with no refunds.
Is there a limit on how many people or pets can stay per site?
Yes, sites allow up to 4 people and 2 pets. Additional fees apply for extra guests or pets beyond that.
What are the check-in and check-out times?
Check-in time is 2 PM and check-out time is 12 PM. Early check-in or late check-out must be approved ahead of time.
Are there any RV restrictions?
We don t allow cargo trailer conversions. All units must be certified RVs. Monthly stays have stricter requirements, so if you have any questions about whether your unit qualifies, we encourage you to contact our office directly.
What size or type of RV can you accommodate?
We can accommodate most RV sizes and types, depending on site availability.
Do you offer hookups and AMP service?
Yes, all of our RV sites have full hookups (water, electric, sewer) and AMP service. The AMP service differs per site:
Premium RV Site 20/30/50/100 amp service
Deluxe RV Site 20/30/50 amp service
Standard RV Site  30 and/or 50 amp service
For more information on our RV sites, please see our RV Sites page.
Are you pet-friendly?
Yes! We re pet-friendly and even have a fenced dog park on-site. We do have a few guidelines to keep all guests and pets comfortable and safe. For full details, check out our Terms & Conditions page.
Do you offer any discounts?
Yes! We offer discounts for veterans, seniors, and Good Sam members. We also run seasonal specials. These are limited-time offers, so follow us on Facebook and Instagram to catch them when they launch.
Can I purchase a day pass to use the pool?
The pool is reserved for registered overnight guests only; we don t offer day passes for pool access. However, we do offer day passes for Merritts Mill Pond, including kayak and canoe rentals, so day visitors can still enjoy the water!
Do you offer day passes for Merritt's Mill Pond?
Day passes are currently $10 + tax. This gives you access to the pond for swimming and our front docks for fishing and swimming. Please note that day passes don t include access to main resort amenities like the pool, clubhouse, or putting greens.
How much are kayak and canoe rentals?
Single kayak: $10/hour or $52/day
Tandem kayak: $20/hour or $62/day
Canoe: $10/hour or $52/day
All rentals are subject to taxes and must be returned by 4:30 PM, which is considered the end of a full rental day.
Finding Us
Florida Caverns RV Resort is located at 4820 Highway 90, Marianna, Florida 32446, in Jackson County in the heart of the Florida Panhandle. We sit just off US Highway 90 near Interstate 10, approximately two hours west of Tallahassee and 90 minutes north of Panama City.

Lodging - Florida Caverns RV Resort
Skip to content
NO RV REQUIRED!
NO RV REQUIRED!
Cabins & Park Models
No RV? No Problem!
Florida Caverns RV Resort offers fully furnished lodging options for guests who want the full resort experience without bringing their own rig. From a cozy rustic fishing cabin to a two-bedroom luxury cabin steps from the water, every option comes move-in ready — just show up and enjoy everything the resort has to offer.
Book Now
Fishing Cabin
Perfect for a quick getaway or a solo retreat, the fishing cabin is a cozy, rustic option right on the resort property. Whether you spend your days out on the pond or relaxing in the shade, this cabin puts you in the middle of it all.
Sleeps 2
Full bed
Full private bathroom
Includes air conditioning and heating, small refrigerator and microwave, complimentary Wi-Fi, access to pool, clubhouse, laundry, boat launch, docks, and white sand beach
Luxury Cabins
Our luxury cabins sit just steps from the shores of Merritt's Mill Pond and are the most popular lodging option at the resort. With two bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private patio, these cabins are ideal for small families, couples traveling together, or anyone who wants a little more room to spread out.
Sleeps 4
1 full-sized bed & 1 queen-sized bed
Full private bathroom
Includes fully equipped kitchen for meal prep, private patio overlooking the resort grounds, fully furnished with all necessary house supplies, electric and complimentary Wi-Fi, access to pool, clubhouse, fitness center, dog park, boat launch, docks, and white sand beach
Park Models
Our park models are the most spacious lodging option at the resort: apartment-style units perfect for extended stays or anyone who wants a true home-away-from-home experience on Merritt's Mill Pond. With a full kitchen, separate bedroom, and living room, everything you need is already here.
Sleeps 4
Separate Master Bedroom
Full private bathroom
Includes fully equipped kitchen with refrigerator, microwave, and stove, air conditioning and heating, complimentary Wi-Fi, electric and internet, access to pool, clubhouse, fitness center, dog park, boat launch, laundry, docks, and white sand beach
Time to Book Your Stay!
Book Now
From the moment you pull in and catch your first glimpse of Merritt's Mill Pond, you'll know you made the right call. Go ahead and book your stay. Your North Florida escape is waiting!

Tent Camping - Florida Caverns RV Resort
Skip to content
PREMIER NORTH FLORIDA RV RESORT
PREMIER NORTH FLORIDA RV RESORT
Tent Camping
Tent Camping at Florida Caverns RV Resort 🏕️
Got a tent and a sense of adventure? We ve got 5 dedicated tent camping sites ready for you. Whether you re bringing the whole family, rolling in with a scout troop, or just craving some fresh air and quiet, this is your spot to get back to basics and enjoy the great outdoors.
We re located right off I-10 in Marianna, FL close enough to grab everything you need, far enough to feel like you ve really gotten away. And with so many great local attractions nearby, we make the perfect home base for exploring the best of North Florida.
Reserve Your Site
Tent Camping
Water Activities
Kayaking
Enjoy Nature
The Full Camping Experience
Our resort has everything you need to make your camping trip an unforgettable adventure. All the best amenities are right at your fingertips, with scenic views of Merritt s Mill Pond just steps away, where you can go for a swim or paddle as soon as you wake up. Here s what our camping sites have to offer:
Grass camping site
Shared bathhouse
Picnic table (subject to availability)
Fire pit (can be rented/purchased as an add-on)
Tent Camping Guidelines
Camping Rules
Pet Guidelines
Cleaning Etiquette
All stays must be 7 days or less.
Only camp in the designated tent camping sites.
Only 1 tent is permitted per site.
Only 1 vehicle is permitted per site. Vehicle camping is not allowed. Any vehicle camping must be done on an RV pad.
Only 4 guests are allowed per site to prevent overcrowding. If more than the permitted number of guests are found per site, you will be charged a fee.
Fire pits and wood can be rented/purchased as add-ons when you book. You may not burn wood from anywhere else.
AC units, space heaters, and generators are not permitted at the tent sites.
Only 1 pet is permitted per site.
Do not leave pets unattended in the tents.
Please review our pet guidelines .
Make sure all garbage has been taken to the dumpsters before leaving and before dark.
All food must be stored in your vehicle overnight and at any time you are not present at your site due to the possibility of wildlife activity.
Please do not wash any dishes in the bathhouse or in the tent site. Go to the office for keys to the clubhouse kitchen for temporary use.
